description: Read the signed-in user’s paid subscription status for a stream package, including price and scheduled cancellation. Returns null when no subscription is found. Use get_stream_subscription for a direct subscription to one stream. Subscribing, changing or cancelling happens in the Synoptic app.

streamPackageId.description: Package ID from list_stream_packages or list_my_stream_packages.

name: get_stream_package_subscription

active.description: True while status is active or trialing.

cancelAt.description: ISO 8601 time the subscription is scheduled to end, or null when no cancellation is scheduled.

customTargets.description: Number of custom targets the subscription allows, or null when the subscription records none; set_stream_custom_targets and patch_stream_custom_targets then accept no targets.

price.description: Price in the currency’s smallest unit.

signupTrial.description: True for a trial started at Synoptic sign-up.

status.description: Stripe subscription status, such as active, trialing, past_due or canceled.

title: Read package subscription
